title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Robert “Bob” Rizzi is a tax lawyer in Holland & Knight’s Washington, D.C., office. Mr. Rizzi advises domestic and multinational businesses on the income tax aspects of corporate and partnership business transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, reorganizations, workouts and joint ventures. He also advises multinational high-net-worth families on transactional, tax planning and cross-border matters. Mr. […]
